P. 10</ls>; दीर्घिकाकमलोन्मेषः <ls>Ku. 2. 33</ls>. .²3 Light, flash, brilliancy; सतां प्रज्ञोन्मेषः <ls>Bh. 2. 114</ls> light or flash; विद्युदुन्मेषदृष्टिम् <ls>Me. 83</ls>. .²4 Awakening, rising, becoming visible, manifestation; ज्ञान˚ <ls>Śānti. 3. 13</ls>. .²5 The act of increasing, supporting, making strong; addition, expansion; इतिहासपुराणानामुन्मेषं निर्मितं च यत् <ls>Mb. 1. 1. 63</ls>.
